translations.translatedText: # Wednesday 27.4.2022 (radio)
Russia's influence attempts. Natural gas deliveries. President Niinistö. National Veterans' Day. Finnair. Weather forecast.
## Russia's influence attempts

![PST's Hans Sverre Sjøvold, Supo's Antti Pelttari and Säpo's Charlotte von Essen held a press conference for the media at the Säätytalo in Helsinki on 27 April.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_3972,h_2234,x_463,y_888/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-9471686269366c21caa/1651062593)
Open image viewer
The security police held a press conference. Photo: Silja Viitala / Yle
The security police of Finland and Sweden have held a joint press conference. The topic was Russia's influencing of Finland and Sweden.

The security police said that Russia has so far not directed specific influence attempts at Finland or Sweden. The reason may be that Russia has concentrated its resources on the attack war in Ukraine.
Finland and Sweden have prepared for Russia to try to influence the NATO debate in Finland and Sweden.
## Russia's gas deliveries
![Gazprom's logo.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-12345150)
Open image viewer
The Russian gas company Gazprom has cut gas deliveries to Poland and Bulgaria. Photo: AOP
Russia has cut natural gas deliveries to Poland and Bulgaria. Russia has demanded that natural gas must be paid for in roubles.
Poland and Bulgaria have not agreed to pay for gas in roubles.
Poland says that it has a lot of natural gas in storage. Bulgaria also says that there is enough gas in Bulgaria for now.
## Niinistö left hospital

![Sauli Niinistö at a press conference in the Presidential Palace.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_4832,h_2714,x_0,y_0/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-9400326250283484f21/1649420650)
Open image viewer
President Niinistö was found to have a corona infection about a week ago. Photo: Otso Ritonummi / Yle
President Sauli Niinistö has got home from hospital on Wednesday.
President Niinistö was in hospital for almost 2 days because of corona symptoms. Niinistö says that he got pneumonia.
Now Niinistö's condition is better. President Niinistö continues to recover and to work at the official residence at Mäntyniemi.
## National Veterans' Day
![Prime Minister Sanna Marin speaks in Lappeenranta.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_1079,h_606,x_0,y_0/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-947171626938b673036/1651064522)
Open image viewer
Prime Minister Sanna Marin spoke at the main national Veterans' Day celebration in Lappeenranta. Photo: Kare Lehtonen / Yle
On Wednesday National Veterans' Day has been celebrated in honour of Finland's war veterans. The main national celebration of Veterans' Day was in Lappeenranta.

Prime Minister Sanna Marin brought the greetings of Finland's state leadership to the veterans' celebration, that is, Marin gave a speech at the celebration. President Niinistö could not take part in the Veterans' Day celebration this year, because Niinistö has a corona infection.
National Veterans' Day is celebrated on 27 April, because the Lapland War ended on 27 April 1945.
## Finnair cuts costs
![A Finnair aircraft in front of the airport.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_5325,h_2995,x_0,y_134/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-9470616269158ac722a/1651054107)
Open image viewer
Finnair has had a difficult time because of corona. Now Russian airspace is closed and it is difficult to fly to Asia. Photo: Esa Syväkuru / Yle
Airline Finnair is starting new savings measures. Finnair's aim is to save 60 million euros more. Finnair had previously announced savings of 200 million euros.
The reason for the savings is that Russia has closed its airspace. That is why Finnair can no longer fly to many destinations in Asia.
Finnair's Asia traffic has been very important to Finnair. Now the situation is very bad for Finnair.
## The weather
![Thursday's weather map](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-12420494)
Open image viewer
On Thursday it is fairly cool.

On Thursday rain, sleet or snow will fall in the west, and elsewhere snow showers will come in places. The weather is cool and the temperature varies around 5 degrees either side; in North Lapland there is a slight frost.
